note: A gate is not DONE simply because it has a visual destination. Visual approval of an isolated Studio is not merge or production approval.

visual_authority.mining: Mining Authored Reference — PASS 3 FINISH, PR #268 frozen composition
visual_authority.wallet: Waterfound-approved authored Wallet Studio direction; source PRs #266/#272 remain separately gated
visual_authority.explorer: Waterfound-approved authored Explorer direction; Studio example ledger is demonstrative, not validated chain data
rules: quiet white space and visual hierarchy
flowing blue for observed activity, not fabricated proof
orange accents only with intended meaning
no generic dashboard filler or decorative sample data in connected mode

non_product_crosswalk.2: Final consensus/DAA, fee-security and strategic mining depend on policy freeze; do not copy Studio numbers
non_product_crosswalk.3: Genesis issuance and exact production chain identity required for validated chain display
non_product_crosswalk.4: Verified network topology/peer identity required for reliable selected-tip/network status
non_product_crosswalk.6: Dry-run and non-activating rehearsal is an operations/readiness surface, not a product launch
non_product_crosswalk.7: Reproducible release is evidenced as a technical provenance/about surface, not decorative marketing
non_product_crosswalk.8: Resource/mempool boundedness and observation origin must be reflected in pending/error views
non_product_crosswalk.9: Physical PoW evidence is not inferred from a render; only measured device evidence qualifies
non_product_crosswalk.10: Final verifier and identity binding required for trustworthy mining/explorer claims
non_product_crosswalk.12: Activation/incident/recovery protocols map to operational state and calm fail-closed communication
non_product_crosswalk.13: User/operator documentation maps to product-context help without unnecessary on-screen text
non_product_crosswalk.14: Final launch freeze remains explicit HUMAN_GATE and is never implied by a visually complete product

gates.source: local miner attempts and measured time window
gates.meaning: Device-local measured work rate, never global hash rate or percentage-to-block
gates.evidence: Measured local attempts/time and mobile/desktop coexistence regression

gates.source: independently verified selected-chain tip and network
gates.meaning: Accepted tip height/hash distinct from next possible candidate height
gates.missing: disconnected/stale last observed; never a confirmed candidate
gates.dependency: final protocol and production wiring pending

gates.source: local watch-only mining address and worker/coordinator state
gates.meaning: Reward address is not an unlocked spending Wallet; switching during mining requires explicit safe state
gates.missing: offline/miner stopped is explicit, never guessed activity
gates.evidence: PR #266 mining guard plus exact authored-product integration replay
gates.dependency: functional vault and authored product candidates not canonically integrated

gates.meaning: No wallets, zero-balance, locked vault and corrupt-vault are four different user states; last active identity persists
gates.missing: never silently create a new wallet or hide corruption
gates.evidence: PR #266 browser bank plus VR-09 W01-W29 replay on exact integrated source
gates.dependency: VR-09 integration and physical Safari gates pending

gates.source: node-verified tip-bound address ledger, active wallet identity
gates.meaning: Confirmations, spendable/immature, pending and precise atom-string balances follow selected identity atomically
gates.missing: unknown/stale balance must not render as zero or cross-wallet value
gates.dependency: real node and integrated Wallet response invalidation pending

gates.source: local vault cryptographic PIN gate only when configured
gates.meaning: Optional PIN must cryptographically restrict secret use; funded-without-PIN affordance only with confirmed known positive balance
gates.missing: unknown balance cannot trigger funded warning; locked cannot sign
gates.evidence: VR-09 W28/W29 KDF/wrapping review, tamper and restart tests
gates.dependency: actual PIN cryptographic design and implementation open

gates.source: validated selected tip, genesis/network identity, actual block data
gates.meaning: Monumental search; confirmed history grows on validated events; ice/blue candidate is unconfirmed height+1 only
gates.missing: offline state shows last observation with timestamp; never moving fake blocks
gates.evidence: PR #294 read contract, final genesis/DP6 and multi-tip reorg integration
gates.dependency: final genesis, verifier path, product read binding open

gates.source: node-local mempool observation with source-node identity
gates.meaning: Pending is node-local observed, not global census; inclusion green only after verified block
gates.missing: pending unknown; do not infer reorg return to mempool
gates.evidence: PR #297 resource bounds, PR #294 live-node provenance and observed-event replay
gates.dependency: actual pending listing not yet implemented

gates.source: validated block/transaction/address index from one selected tip
gates.meaning: Search, pagination, details and amounts use exact public node records, not Studio sample ledger
gates.evidence: PR #294 six read routes, real-node E2E and stable-cursor adversarial tests
gates.dependency: end-to-end actual read source and product integration open

gates.source: independently checked chain selection and transaction status
gates.meaning: Confirmed, reorganized, dropped/unobserved and rejected remain distinct
gates.missing: no false guarantee of finality or mempool reinsertion
gates.evidence: node reorg and orphan-path replay on final network configuration

gates.meaning: quiet explicit available/stale/hold state with next useful recovery action
gates.missing: HOLD must never be colored as healthy or silently bypassed
gates.evidence: PR #63 separate node readiness, partition/restart/incident drills
gates.dependency: production topology and selected runtime pending

gates.source: reproducible artifact manifest and dry-run logs
gates.meaning: release provenance is verifiable and discoverable without adding visual clutter to normal Wallet/Mining
gates.missing: artifact not verified = candidate, never release-ready
gates.evidence: draft PRs #98/#100 exact-source reproducibility and rehearsal replay
gates.dependency: candidate branches and clean-room attestation not canonically closed

gates.source: explicit approved activation record and release/incident runbook
gates.meaning: network launch/readiness displayed only from an authoritative approved state
gates.missing: mainnet HOLD until all final freeze + human authorization gates
gates.evidence: final consensus freeze, recovery rehearsal, exact launch artifact and explicit Waterfound approval

gates.source: verified test-class evidence and user/operator instructions
gates.meaning: meaningful device and node statuses with accessible concise explanations, not status decoration
gates.missing: unknown hardware evidence must remain unclaimed
gates.evidence: iPad HFB/RDE/MTS plus thin-light, consumer dGPU and compact handheld representative evidence
